title: Eve Gallagher & Uli Heinzler deliver a blues anthem with "Freedom"
htmlContent:
With "Freedom," Eve Gallagher and Uli Heinzler have taken us to an environment with their latest single. This is the blues returned, with passion, direction, and a lot of groove indeed. Eve Gallagher's delivery is the song's emotional anchor, transforming the word "freedom" into something alive. Uli Heinzler's bass and deft production work beat with an accuracy below her strong vocal presence, rooting the track in a groove that is irresistibly locked-in while remaining emotionally justified.

https://open.spotify.com/track/65NhDGlhUJdlg6y4OdY0hH

They are joined by an elite slate of world-class players who lift the single into something greater. Ondrej Pivec from Gregory Porter's group brings the smoky fire of his own with the Hammond organ, which leaves a fun head of such seductive material throughout. Jack Pearson, who has worked with the Allman Brothers Band, brings expressive guitar playing that effortlessly dances between grit and elegance. And Roman Roth (Simply Red) slams the point home with fantastic feel on the drums.

Together, they create a sound that rocks and moves and feels deeply human, a track you want to party to just as much as contemplate. "Freedom," which captures that timeless blues spirit while dressing it in contemporary, groove-centric energy that's classic and new all at once. Ultimately, this song serves as a poignant reminder that freedom is a choice that we must make. Gallagher and Heinzler express the blues, and not just play it.
